title: Gộp loại bàn và không gian vào modal quản lý bàn
rootCause: The table settings modal is contextual to TableManagement but its trigger was still exposed as a standalone global navigation/search choice. The fix removes that choice and passes the existing controlled-modal opener directly into an in-page table management wrapper.

removed the standalone sidebar item and manager search result
added a permission-gated in-page button using the existing controlled modal opener
kept stale table-types hash normalization, table.write permission checks, restaurant scope and modal CRUD unchanged
added focused component coverage for opening the modal and hiding the trigger without an opener
